title: The Long And Winding Road by The Beatles
lyrics_synced:
[00:03.01] The long and winding road
[00:08.00] that leads to your door
[00:16.79] will never disappear
[00:23.03] I've seen that road before
[00:29.61] It always leads me here
[00:36.21] Lead me to your door
[00:41.41] The wild and windy night
[00:46.40] that the rain washed away
[00:55.19] has left a pool of tears crying for the day
[01:08.01] Why leave me standing here?
[01:14.61] Let me know the way
[01:20.01] Many times I've been alone
[01:23.05] and many times I've cried
[01:26.40] Anyway you'll never know
[01:29.45] the many ways I've tried
[01:32.61] And still they lead me back
[01:37.60] to the long winding road
[01:46.40] You left me standin' here
[01:52.63] a long long time ago
[01:59.21] Don't leave me waiting here
[02:05.81] Lead me to your door
[02:23.60] But still they lead me back
[02:28.80] to the long winding road
[02:37.59] You left me standin' here
[02:43.83] a long long time ago
[02:50.41] Don't leave me waiting here
[02:57.01] Lead me to your door
